observation: The bundled CLIs disagree about long-option syntax. agent-kanban states 'Value-taking long options accept both --name=value and --name value'. agent-session does not: 'agent-loop session checkpoint <id> --title="review blindspots" --body "..."' fails with 'Error: A checkpoint requires a --title.' as if the option had not been passed at all, and only '--title "review blindspots"' works.

evidence.summary: agent-loop session checkpoint <id> --title="review blindspots" --body "..." -> Error: A checkpoint requires a --title. The same command with --title "review blindspots" -> Recorded checkpoint 001.

hypothesis: Each bundled package parses argv itself instead of sharing one option parser, and agent-session only implements the space-separated form.
validated_conclusion: Either accept --name=value everywhere, or make the error say that the option was not recognised in the given form instead of reporting it as missing - the current message sends the caller looking for a typo in the value.
